description:
Laado Protsahan Yojana was launched by the Government of India on 1st January 2019. 

This scheme is specifically aimed at empowering the girl child in the state of Haryana. 

The initiative was introduced in response to the alarming gender imbalance in Haryana, where the sex ratio was reported at 879 females for every 1,000 males according to the 2011 Census. 

The primary objective of the Laado Protsahan Yojana is to promote the education of girls and to provide financial assistance to families for the education of their daughters. 

The scheme aims to improve the overall status of girls in society by encouraging families to educate their daughters rather than resorting to gender discrimination. 

One of the measurable targets of the scheme is to increase the enrollment of girls in schools and colleges by at least 10% annually. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the dropout rate of girls in schools by 5% each year. 

Under the Laado Protsahan Yojana, financial assistance is provided to families based on the educational qualifications of their daughters. 

Families can receive a financial incentive of ₹5,000 for the admission of their daughters into Class 1. 

An additional ₹5,000 is provided when the girl reaches Class 6. 

When the girl completes Class 10, the family receives another ₹10,000. 

Finally, a sum of ₹15,000 is given upon the completion of Class 12. 

This brings the total financial assistance to ₹35,000 for families who ensure that their daughters complete their education up to Class 12. 

Eligibility for the Laado Protsahan Yojana is primarily based on the age of the girl child. 

The scheme is applicable to girls who are residents of Haryana. 

The girl must be born on or after 1st January 2019 to be eligible for the scheme. 

Families must also meet certain income criteria to qualify for the financial assistance. 

The annual income of the family should not exceed ₹1.80 lakh. 

There are no specific educational requirements for the girl child to qualify for the scheme. 

However, the family must ensure that the girl is enrolled in a recognized school. 

The application process for the Laado Protsahan Yojana is straightforward. 

Families need to visit the official website of the Haryana Government's Women and Child Development Department. 

They must fill out the application form available online. 

Required documents include the birth certificate of the girl child. 

Families must also provide proof of residence in Haryana. 

Income proof is required to verify that the family meets the income criteria. 

Additionally, a copy of the admission receipt from the school is necessary for the application. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The disbursement of financial assistance is done directly to the bank account of the beneficiary. 

The timeline for the disbursement of funds is usually within 30 days of the application approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development, Haryana. 

The contact details for the department can be found on their official website. 

The Laado Protsahan Yojana has seen a positive response since its inception. 

As of October 2023, over 50,000 girls have benefited from the scheme. 

The initiative has contributed to a gradual improvement in the sex ratio in Haryana. 

The government has reported an increase in the enrollment of girls in schools by 12% since the launch of the scheme. 

The dropout rate for girls has also decreased by 7% in the same period. 

The scheme has been promoted through various awareness campaigns across the state. 

These campaigns aim to educate families about the importance of girl child education. 

The Laado Protsahan Yojana is part of a broader initiative by the Government of India to promote gender equality. 

It aligns with the national Beti Bachao Beti Padhao scheme launched in 2015. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from various NGOs and women's rights organizations. 

They have praised the government for taking steps to empower girls in a patriarchal society. 

The Laado Protsahan Yojana is also supported by local bodies and community leaders. 

They play a crucial role in spreading awareness about the benefits of the scheme. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for the implementation of this scheme for the financial year 2023-2024. 

This budget is aimed at ensuring that the financial assistance reaches the intended beneficiaries without delays. 

The scheme is expected to continue evolving based on feedback from beneficiaries and stakeholders. 

The government is committed to addressing any challenges that arise during the implementation of the Laado Protsahan Yojana. 

Regular monitoring and evaluation are conducted to assess the impact of the scheme on girl child education in Haryana. 

The Laado Protsahan Yojana represents a significant step towards achieving gender parity in education. 

It provides a structured financial incentive that encourages families to invest in their daughters' education. 

The scheme not only aims to improve educational outcomes but also seeks to change societal attitudes towards the girl child. 

By providing financial support at critical educational milestones, the scheme aims to ensure that girls complete their schooling. 

The Laado Protsahan Yojana is a testament to the Government of India's commitment to women's empowerment. 

It reflects a growing recognition of the importance of education in achieving gender equality. 

The scheme is expected to have long-term benefits for society as a whole. 

Educated women contribute significantly to economic development and social progress. 

The Laado Protsahan Yojana is a crucial initiative in building a more equitable society in Haryana and beyond.
